head.name: @fzlt/core/touch
head.lead: Taps and swipes on an animation or a game never zoom or pan the page. One delegated listener set on the document (capture, not passive) cancels, on the surfaces that match sel, what CSS touch-action can't: iOS Safari's gesturestart / gesturechange (its pinch, which ignores user-scalable=no) and any multi-touch touchstart / touchmove (a pinch anywhere else). One finger is never touched, so taps, drags and the page's own scroll stay. The CSS half lives in the Board UI kit (board-ui.css): touch-action: manipulation on the page (no double-tap zoom) and touch-action: none / pan-y plus overscroll-behavior: none on the same surfaces. Pass null to lock the whole page (a full-screen board; content pages keep pinch-zoom for WCAG 1.4.4). Returns release(): the page gets its gestures back.

STATUS · what the flags meanBETA

Tested and budgeted; not yet carried by a shipped game, or its API is still moving. Shipped now; COMPLETE also asks that its API has had no breaking change since it shipped, which is still to be confirmed.

SINCE
v0.20.0
SHIPPED IN
  • Null Invaders 1.0.3, Byte Runner 1.0.2 and Sherman Bytes 1.1.0 (through @fzlt/core/arcade: no page zoom while a run is live)
  • the DOM Battlefield and Battlefield Blitz sites
  • fizlet.com: every page

lockTouch(document, null); // a full-screen board: the whole page
